Deploy the callback sender:

```
forge create --broadcast --rpc-url $RN_RPC_URL --private-key $REACTIVE_PRIVATE_KEY src/micro-demos/CallbackSender.sol:CallbackSender
```

Export deployed address to `RCT`.

Deploy the recipient contract (the first argument is the 2.0 callback proxy address on the omni fork of Sepolia, substitute as appropriate):

```
forge create --broadcast --rpc-url $SEPOLIA_RPC_URL --private-key $SEPOLIA_PRIVATE_KEY --value 0.2ether src/micro-demos/CallbackRecipient.sol:CallbackRecipient --constructor-args 0x082caFba1641ACCc607939670B5F5aa6f1bEeA46 $RCT
```

Export deployed addres to `CBK`.

Finish the configuration of the callback sender contract:

```
cast send --rpc-url $RN_RPC_URL --private-key $REACTIVE_PRIVATE_KEY $RCT "setCounterParty(address)" $CBK
```

Trigger the callback:

```
cast send --rpc-url http://100.95.243.217:39599/ --private-key $REACTIVE_PRIVATE_KEY $RCT "ping()"
```
